defect_found.summary: downgrade 对 app_role 使用宽泛 GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA，超出父态（7a8b9c0d1e2f）实际窄权限

remediation.approach: 按父态实测权限逐表还原，不再使用 ALL TABLES 宽泛授权
